Full summary: Reviewed uncommitted fixes for the two 1.24.0 field bugs (bare ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} guard form in plugin/.mcp.json; login-PATH merge + well-known-dir fallback in plugin/scripts/launch-server.sh; new regression tests). Local run of test/hooks/launch-server.test.ts: 31/31 pass. Findings: (1) blocker — plugin version files still 1.24.0 while CHANGELOG declares Plugin [1.24.1]; must run scripts/bump-plugin-version.sh 1.24.1 so both version files update and the committed server bundle rebuilds, else CI plugin-version-check fails. (2) important — session-start-context.sh:90 probes the launcher through `sh -lc`, which reimposes the replace-PATH semantics the launcher fix just removed: a ~/.profile that clobbers PATH makes the probe lose the inherited PATH the real `sh -c` spawn keeps, so the hook can inject a false 'server unavailable' warning while the server actually starts; probe should drop the login wrapper now that the launcher merges the login PATH internally. (3) minor — hook comment (lines 74-76) and runner=none warning text (line 118, 'not resolvable even from a login shell') understate the new recovery (well-known dirs also probed). (4) minor — README rung-3 wording ('npx from the login-shell PATH') and absence of merge/well-known-dir fallback in the ladder docs. (5) minor — docs/UPGRADE-v2.md:123 parity claim ('exactly what the plugin's bundled server does') now false.
Decisions: Chose to flag the session-start-context.sh sh -lc probe wrapper as an important divergence rather than a nit — the launcher's new merge semantics make the outer login shell the only remaining place where a clobbering ~/.profile can hide a workable inherited PATH, producing a false 'tools are absent' warning in exactly the field scenario the fix targets; before the fix probe and spawn failed identically so the wrapper was harmless.; Chose NOT to flag the undocumented TWINING_LAUNCH_RECOVERY_DIRS env var — it is a test seam consistent with the pre-existing undocumented TWINING_LAUNCH_NO_LOGIN_PATH seam, so documenting it is not required for this change.
